run_two_layer_simulation: run the two-layer teacher-student network simulation with hydra config and save stats to pickle
run_forward_backward: run forward and backward passes through a two-layer network with optional ReLU nonlinearity
init_teacher_student_weights: initialize teacher and student weight matrices with optional adversarial or helpful initialization strategies
compute_boundary_observability: compute the boundary observability matrix measuring student-teacher activation alignment across decision boundaries
eval_phrase_correlations: evaluate and log correlation matrices between teacher and student hidden activations on train and eval sets
